result.description:
For nearly 25 years, APD Global has set the benchmark in delivering advanced, comprehensive, and specialised engineering solutions.

We have around 800 employees including our alliance contracting partners, across 15 strategically located offices in Australia (Perth, Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Adelaide, Darwin), New Zealand and Malaysia. We specialise in seamless integration across the Power Systems, Telecommunications, and Renewable Energy industries. Our expertise spans Power Systems Studies, Transmission Lines, Substations, Telecommunications, Protection, Control & Automation, Renewable Energy Connections, Mining, and Engineering, Protection Panel Design and Installation, 3D Design and Manufacturing as well as Construction/Management (EPC/M) services.

We have outstanding opportunity for a highly experienced ACCEPTANCE ENGINEER. We are looking for trustworthy individuals with integrity who will bring a positive can-do attitude to the position and to the team. Position available in Vic, Qld, WA, and NSW.

Role Overview
The Acceptance Engineer works under the direction of the Acceptance Lead to support the successful acceptance, handover, and integration of new and upgraded network assets into Telstra’s operational environment. The role is responsible for ensuring all documentation, as-built records, and asset data are accurate, compliant, and correctly uploaded into Telstra’s DBoR systems in accordance with program and governance requirements.

KEY RESPONSIBILITY

ACCEPTANCE & HANDOVER
Support the Acceptance Lead in managing the end-to-end acceptance process for Telstra network assets.
Review and validate construction completion packs, ensuring readiness for acceptance and operational handover.
Facilitate the smooth transition of assets from delivery teams into Telstra operational ownership.

DOCUMENTATION & AS-BUILTS
Ensure all project documentation, including as-built drawings, design updates, and asset data, is accurate, complete, and compliant.
Upload and validate as-built information within Telstra’s DBoR systems upon project completion.
Maintain document version control and ensure alignment between physical assets and system records.

DBoR SYSTEM MANAGEMENT
Create, update, and validate asset records using Telstra’s legacy and current DBoR platforms, including: IDEAL, CANRAD, Structure Builder, MITS, RODS, RFNSA, CADlink, Multiman, CRAMER, TPD, WHISPER, TCSS, NETMAPS, WidePlan, Widefeas, CMART, and TRAC.
Resolve data discrepancies and support data quality audits as required by the program.

STAKEHOLDER COORDINATION
Work closely with the Acceptance Lead, internal Telstra teams, delivery partners, and external contractors to coordinate acceptance activities.
Support issue resolution relating to site access, design compliance, documentation gaps, and system data conflicts.
Act as a key interface between construction, design, and operational teams during acceptance and handover.

COMPLIANCE & GOVERNANCE
Ensure all works comply with Telstra design guidelines, relevant Australian Standards, and WHS/safety requirements.
Support program governance by ensuring acceptance processes align with Telstra policies and audit requirements.
Assist with continuous improvement initiatives across acceptance and handover processes.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE/QUALIFICATIONS
Experience working in network acceptance, handover, or asset management roles within Telstra or similar telecommunications environments.
Strong working knowledge of Telstra DBoR systems and acceptance workflows.
Ability to interpret engineering designs, construction drawings, and as-built documentation.
Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills.
High attention to detail with a focus on data accuracy and compliance.

If you have the skills required for this role and you feel this is the job for you, then apply now!
Work Location: Melbourne, Vic
Salary: $80,000 per annum + Super

result.description:
IT Systems Analyst
Full-time
Glow Health Care Australia Pty Ltd trading as Glow Health Care Australia
Parramatta, NSW
Salary: $80,000–$100,000 plus superannuation
About the Role
Glow Health Care Australia is seeking an experienced IT Systems Analyst to support and improve the technology systems used across our disability, aged care, home care, allied health and NDIS service operations.
In this role, you will work with managers, employees, external vendors and technology teams to identify business needs, analyse existing systems and implement practical technology solutions. You will help ensure our systems are secure, reliable, compliant and aligned with the organisation’s operational requirements.
Duties and Responsibilities
•	Analyse existing systems, applications and business processes to identify opportunities for improvement. 
•	Consult with stakeholders to gather and document functional and technical requirements. 
•	Translate business requirements into system designs and technical specifications. 
•	Prepare system workflows, process maps, data mappings and functional documentation. 
•	Recommend system enhancements, new applications and improvements to existing platforms. 
•	Coordinate the implementation and rollout of new systems and system upgrades. 
•	Develop and conduct system, integration and user acceptance testing. 
•	Investigate system defects and coordinate resolutions with vendors and development teams. 
•	Support the integration of third-party applications with internal systems and platforms. 
•	Monitor system interfaces and data flows to maintain accuracy and interoperability. 
•	Prepare user guides, technical procedures, training materials and system documentation. 
•	Provide Level 2 and Level 3 support for complex system-related issues. 
•	Assist with staff training and change-management activities during system implementations. 
•	Ensure systems comply with privacy, cybersecurity, data-governance and healthcare requirements. 
•	Conduct post-implementation reviews and recommend further system improvements. 
Skills and Qualifications
•	Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Information Systems or a related discipline. 
•	At least two to three years of relevant experience as a Systems Analyst, Business Systems Analyst or in a similar ICT position. 
•	Experience analysing, implementing and supporting organisational or enterprise systems. 
•	Strong knowledge of requirements gathering, process mapping and technical documentation. 
•	Experience with system integration, APIs, databases and data modelling. 
•	Experience conducting integration testing and user acceptance testing. 
•	Familiarity with SQL, Visio, Jira, Confluence or similar tools. 
•	Understanding of Agile, Waterfall or other software-development methodologies. 
•	Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. 
•	Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
•	Ability to communicate technical information clearly to non-technical stakeholders. 
•	Knowledge of information security, privacy and data-governance principles. 
•	Experience in healthcare, disability, aged care, community services or NDIS operations is desirable. 
•	ITIL, CBAP, PRINCE2 or similar certification would be advantageous. 
How to Apply
Please submit your résumé and a cover letter outlining your relevant qualifications and experience.
Glow Health Care Australia is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applications from suitably qualified candidates from all backgrounds.
